assertion_analysis.assertion: base/head actual subject contents remain distinct (lines 230-231)
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Archive head for both arms or archive base for both; actual file contents differ from the fixed independent fixture expectations.
Use the inherited directory or another root; node_tmp is a separately established simulated node filesystem, not the TMPDIR value handed to the production runner.
Omit export TMPDIR="$scratch" or export the root instead; tree and tmpdir are independently printed by the executed child.

assertion_analysis.assertion: inherited path absent from actual output
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Export or execute under the submitter path; child prints tmpdir and checkout location.
Recreate the absent inherited directory; supplemental side-effect check, not standalone evidence of correct allocation.
Remove cleanup or make it target a different directory, leaving the executed checkout behind.

assertion_analysis.assertion: recorded mktemp TMPDIR values equal literal /tmp
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Omit or move the reset after mktemp; the shim logs the actual environment before invoking the real allocator.
Use file allocation or omit one allocation; the recorder observes actual child argv.
Restore a TMPDIR-derived template; expected NODE_TEMP_ROOT is a test-owned literal, not imported from production.
Suppress all arm launches; prevents per-call assertions passing over an empty list.
Restore the inherited path or remove the reset, as demonstrated by both red parameter cases.
Move reset after allocation or checkout before allocation.
Reinstall trap after mktemp; startup failure would lack a receipt and cleanup.

assertion_analysis.assertion: private-directory export occurs between allocation and checkout
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Omit the export or move it below git.
Restore inherited-TMPDIR template or allocate outside the node-local root.
Reintroduce the specific ${TMPDIR:-...} bootstrap that accepted submitter storage; supplemental syntax check.
Embed the submitter scratch path in the job; supplemental literal-path check.

assertion_analysis.assertion: batch environment TMPDIR equals test literal /tmp
assertion_analysis.fails_if: Remove the newly added env reset, retaining monkeypatched inherited TMPDIR; production and expected sides do not move together.

assertion_analysis.assertion: inherited directory remains empty or absent (lines 340-342)
assertion_analysis.fails_if: An implementation-side local write touches the submitter directory; the recording runner does not execute scripts, so these are fixture side-effect checks and receive no independent durability credit.

findings.text: The repair importer evidence was produced by direct subprocess.run calls inside fleet job 1291586 rather than a separate partition job: resume-1.jsonl records inline base/head pytest -n 4 commands, and tmpdir-base-importers.log and tmpdir-head-importers.log report 157.31 s and 287.19 s respectively. These are heavy gates under the workstation rule; rerun both importer arms through separate sbatch jobs on all_debug or rigel and update the evidence before accepting it.
